title: RePAIR: Predictive Self-Supervised Representation Learning in Chess
abstract: arXiv:2606.11860v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In this paper, we introduce Representation Prediction via Autoencoding using Iterative Refinement (RePAIR) - a novel self-supervised representation learning architecture that synthesizes Masked Autoencoders (MAE), Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA), and Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT). We demonstrate how it can be used to encode objects in sequential data like consecutive chess positions into compact yet meaningful representations. The basic principle of the architecture is to mask large portions of a sequence of latent states, similar to BERT and MAE. Then, we apply a lightweight Predictor to the latent representations that repairs gaps in the sequence in a lower-dimensional embedding space akin to JEPA. translated_title: RePAIR：国际象棋中的预测式自监督表征学习
translated_abstract: 在本文中，我们提出了通过迭代精炼实现自编码表征预测（RePAIR）——一种新颖的自监督表征学习架构，它融合了掩码自编码器（MAE）、联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）以及基于Transformer的双向编码器表征（BERT）。我们展示了如何利用该架构将序列数据中的对象（如连续的国际象棋局面）编码为紧凑而有意义的表征。该架构的基本原理类似于BERT和MAE：掩蔽潜在状态序列中的大部分内容，然后应用一个轻量级的预测器（Predictor）在低维嵌入空间中修复序列中的空缺，这与JEPA的思想类似。我们在国际象棋领域的实验表明，编码器（Encoder）能够不断精炼棋盘表征，使得有意义的国际象棋概念在潜在空间中形成聚类。此外，重建……
tldr: 本文提出RePAIR架构，融合MAE、JEPA与BERT的思想，通过掩蔽潜在状态序列并用轻量级预测器在低维嵌入空间中修复空缺，实现了对国际象棋局面序列的自监督表征学习，使有意义的棋类概念在潜在空间中自然聚类。
